messages:
maya: Heads-up — thinking we should try a short 10-min overnight lightning handoff starting tonight to keep the incident queue tidy. Quick agenda I had in mind:
1) very brief open incidents roll-up
2) who owns any escalations overnight
3) immediate blockers + follow-ups to log.
Can folks join at 11:50pm PT? I can lead and keep it to 10.

liam: I can make 11:50pm PT. +1 to keeping it short. Who else is on the escalation rotation after me? @devon?

devon: Yep I’m on backup till 02:00 PT. I can take escalations if something needs deep dives. I’ll be available for the brief.

sam: I’m on call but out for dinner until 11:40 — should be able to join by 11:52. If anything critical hits before then, tag me. :eyes:

anya: Quick Q — should we invite SRE on every night or only when there are sev>=2? Last time we pulled SRE for a noisy low-priority alert and it burned cycles.

maya: Good call. Proposal: SRE added if there’s any sev2+ or if more than 2 distinct services have active incidents. Otherwise keep it to oncall + backup. Thoughts?

liam: I like that. Also propose we build a 1-line incident rollup template so the brief is uniform. Something like:
```
- Incident: service/name (sev) — current owner — ETA for next action
```
That keeps it fast.

maya: Perfect. I’ll paste that template in the channel before handoff.

oncall-bot: Reminder: current oncall rotation: @liam (primary) until 00:30 PT, backup @devon until 02:00 PT. Link to oncall runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall

devon: I can also grab incident #3412 (high CPU) if it’s still noisy. @maya can you add that to the rollup?

maya: Added #3412 to the rollup. Draft agenda posted below and I’ll DM a final ping 5m before start.

maya: AGENDA (10 minutes):
- 0:00–0:02 quick rollup (each incident 1 line)
- 0:02–0:06 escalation owners & immediate blockers
- 0:06–0:09 needed SRE/dev handoffs / runbook links
- 0:09–0:10 confirm owners + log follow-ups

sam: Sounds good. Can we also add a one-line follow-up task owner for any incident we hand off? So nothing gets lost in the morning.

maya: Yes — mandatory follow-up owner on each incident in the rollup. I’ll enforce it during the brief.

ops-bot: FYI — nighttime pager threshold adjusted to reduce noisy low-impact alerts between 23:00–05:00 PT. See config: `pager:threshold:low_noise_filter=true`

liam: Thanks ops-bot. One more ask: if you’re leading the brief @maya, please record a 30s note in the incident channel listing owners so the morning shift can pick up quickly.

maya: Will do. Ok team — we’ll run tonight 11:50pm PT in #eng-oncall. I’ll start the thread and keep it 10 mins. Ping me if you can’t make it. :thumbsup:
